spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶3. ** And this: The interior qualities of understanding , and the forms of perception , appear inverted when they are seen within natural truth — as though turned upside down. This sign ifies the mystery of the Divine Call , when it was sent down into the states of falsity and spiritual darkness toward the Celestial Human. For divine truth, desc ending, cast itself down ward into those lowest states — as one who plunges headf irst into natural truth . So it is with every infl ux from the Divine: it c asts itself with power and urgency into the states below , and in doing so appears reversed , for what is highest in the spiritual sense becomes lowest in the natural sense, and what is in most appears ou termost.

**¶4 .** And this too: Should the understanding begin to lift itself up ward out of merely natural truth, its own interior quality is not yet visible to itself, because it remains bent toward what is below . This corresponds to the mystery of the responsive truth — the obedience — that ascended from the lowest states, rising from the Celestial Human toward the Living Divine Spirit . For when truth first begins its return toward the Divine, the mind cannot yet perceive its own spiritual face ; self -knowledge is hidden so long as the interior understanding is still inc lined toward natural and sensory things.

**¶ 5.** The interior qualities of understanding , of affection, and of perception are all visible within natural truth, yet they appear inverted — hanging as it were upside down. This is the mystery of the interior spiritual kn owledges and the celest ial order itself , which, when reflected into the gathered body of natural truth — the great sea of the external mind — appear in reversed form . For the qualities of understanding, the living aff ections, and all forms of perception are ro oted in, and begotten from, those interior kn owledges and that celestial order. Just as their spiritual origins — which are spread out in the higher regions of the mind — are themselves oriented toward what is below them ( for all that is celest ial b ends itself down ward in love toward what is beneath it), so likewise the mystery of their spiritual origin is revealed to those who contem plate natural truth. Whoever looks deeply into the mirror of natural knowledge finds every spiritual form inverted there : what was highest appears lowest , what was inmost appears outermost. This is the universal law of correspondence between the spiritual world and the natural world.

** ¶6.** Not only this, but consider what is newly born in regener ation: as the hour approaches for the new spiritual life to enter the natural world, it enters inv erted — the in most and highest principle descends first into the ou termost and lowest. In every reb irth, the head — which is the ruling love and in most understanding — must enter the natural state before the rest can follow . The highest becomes what is first received into the lowest . And this mystery is revealed whenever one ga zes into natural tru ths, for there one sees that every spiritual birth follows this same law of in version: heaven enters the world head first, and what is supreme in origin appears first in what is most external .

**¶7.** You will find that the natural image of a person — the corpor eal shadow — is joined to what is earth ly and external at all times. If the spirit within is troubled, still its natural image c lings to the earth and cannot be separated from it. It is impossible for the external form to lift itself away from the corpor eal plane by its own power. Behold, this is a great sign: the entire external and bod ily nature originated from what is earth ly and sens ory, having been drawn up ward from the deep est a byss of merely corpor eal life . And because of this origin , its shadow — its natural appearance — remains forever joined to the earth, t ending downward, even while it is sustained and held from above by the spirit . The natural can never free itself from its own plane ; it han gs from the spiritual as a shadow hangs from the body that c asts it, always touching the ground , always pointing toward the lowest degree of existence .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?
Happen you know this, that this universe is established [of m]ystery, and is entirely full of mystery.

[And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce the summons went forth from the realm of light,] in this way it cast itself down [to the abyss,] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.

And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit.

The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.

Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.

Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [, he can not raise] his shadow up upon the earth [to] above. It is impossible for him to do [this, for it remains joined to its place] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.
